newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Kuwait exchange to list local securities company.
newsitem.headline: Kuwait exchange to list local securities company.

text.p: The Kuwait Stock Exchange said on Wednesday it has approved a listing request by Kuwait's Securities Group.
"The group's share will be traded as of December 21," a KSE official said. "The market committee has approved the company's request," he said.

The state sold 300 million shares of its majority stake in the Securities Group earlier this year under a privatisation programme that aims at shedding the government's holdings in some 60 local firms and public services.
The firm, which manages investment portfolios, trades securities and provides consultancy and brokerage services, was established in October 1981.

In 1995 the firm made a net profit of 5.27 million dinars compared to a loss of 656,000 dinars in 1994 and a profit of five million dinars in 1993. It has a paid up capital of 33 million dinars and 330 million issued shares.
Total market capitalisation is about 4.1 billion dinars with 58 listed Kuwaiti and Gulf shares.
Trade on the exchange is restricted to the nationals of the Gulf Cooperation Council which groups Kuwait, Saudi Arabia, Bahrain, Oman, Qatar and the United Arab Emirates.
